4490-8036--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-8036--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Christine Chapel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-8036--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

4871-5220-6495-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-6495-7806.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
4871-5220-6495-7806.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate Sisay's Ring by tapping it, adding six mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sisay's Ring which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.

1453-4559-6797-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-4559-6797-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

880-6664-7201.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6664-7201.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.

2471-6972.description:
Kill Zabaz.
When Zabaz dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Zabaz from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Zabaz dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Ornithopter, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

57-3480-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3480-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Indoraptor trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Indoraptor instead of you due to With Great Power....
Repeat from step 2.

When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

618-997-4344.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When the Lumbering Battlement token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Lumbering Battlement token.
When the Lumbering Battlement token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1061-1576-4013.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Plant, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G} and sacrificing the three Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.

Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Gruul Turf and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

1029-2757-4007.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.

Reckless Racer triggers, causing you to rummage.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Reckless Racer.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

2232-3821-4336.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
2232-3821-4336.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3554-4582-4872.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.

Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Beseech the Queen and Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.

968-2660-4772.notablePrerequisites: Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
968-2660-4772.description:
Cast Jace, Architect of Thought for {2}{U}{U} which enters with 8 loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Jace's -8, putting it on the bottom of your library.
Search you library for Jace and exile it, and exile a nonland card of your choice.
Cast Jace along with any of the nonland cards you wish to cast.
Repeat from step 2.
